edges.description: The fusion drives the tumour's growth: BRD4-NUT and NSD3-NUT each keep NUT carcinoma cells proliferating, and the mouse Brd4::Nutm1 fusion induces aggressive carcinomas in mice. How that growth becomes a rapidly enlarging mass in a patient is not in the cited sources.
The fusion protein brings a histone acetyltransferase onto chromatin.
Acetylation is concentrated into the megadomains and depleted elsewhere.
The megadomains sit over a small recurrent set of transcription factor loci.

No mechanism node of this entry sits between the spread and the nodal involvement, so the link is marked direct. Nodal involvement is often present at diagnosis, at least with a thoracic primary: a review of published primary pulmonary cases says most had lymph node metastases at the initial imaging, and regional nodes were involved in 34 of the 37 whose nodal status was recorded.

No mechanism node of this entry sits between the spread and a distant deposit, so the link is marked direct. Distant metastatic disease is often present at diagnosis with a thoracic primary, less often with a non-thoracic one, if the registry's figures on the Early Metastatic Spread node are read as distant spread: the registry's cached text does not define metastatic disease, but the common metastatic sites it lists are bone, pleura and distant lymph nodes. In published primary pulmonary cases distant metastasis was found in 21 of the 39 whose status was recorded, most often in bone.

The immune-biomarker review gives the low mutational burden, with microsatellite stability and PD-L1 negativity, as the reason the tumour is called cold, and the registry report calls it cold without giving one. No cited source measures neoantigens in this tumour or shows that the low burden causes a sparse immune infiltrate, so the step is that review's reading, not a demonstrated mechanism. Against it, the same review restates a prediction, made with HLA typing and binding-affinity modelling, that peptides spanning the BRD4::NUTM1 junction may bind some HLA-C types with high affinity and could trigger T-cell responses despite a low burden; that is a computational proposal.

edges.limitations: The fusion is formed by the mouse syntenic t(2;17), not the human t(15;19), and only the BRD4 partner is modelled - the report covers no BRD3 or NSD3 fusion, so it says nothing about the two partners this entry curates separately.

edges.description: The mouse tumours are poorly differentiated and carry areas of squamous differentiation and keratinization in variable proportion, which is the human pattern this node records - a block to complete squamous differentiation rather than an absence of it. Fifty mouse tumours were scored for that by a veterinary pathologist.
edges.limitations: The scoring covers head-and-neck and skin tumours, the sites a basal-keratinocyte Cre driver produces, so the squamous reading is strongest where the driver put the tumour. Whether the same holds at the mediastinal and other midline sites this disease occupies in people is not addressed.

nodes.description: The mechanism-directed approach. Three agents have cached clinical data in this disease, all early phase and all modest: two of four compassionate-use patients responded to OTX015; four of nineteen reached a confirmed or unconfirmed partial response on molibresib; two of eight on RO6870810. The report of an international symposium on NUT carcinoma grades first-generation BET inhibitors as modestly effective in a minority of cases, with a narrow therapeutic window.

nodes.description: Preclinical, plus one patient described in a cited primary study. Restoring bulk acetylation engages squamous differentiation and arrests growth in vitro, and HDAC inhibitor differentiation therapy produced significant growth inhibition and a survival benefit in three xenograft models; a single child treated with vorinostat had an objective response. A review of published primary pulmonary cases also counts six patients given BET or HDAC inhibitors in later lines, without separating the two classes, and reports no clear benefit, and a paper cited here for its dataset says in its discussion, citing other reports, that HDAC inhibitors have been used clinically with anecdotal tumour regression. The preclinical study's authors grade their work as support for a trial, and this entry does not grade it higher.

nodes.description: The tumour is generally described as immunologically cold. The immune-biomarker review infers the label from biomarkers - little PD-L1, a low mutational burden and microsatellite stability - and the registry report states it without a reason. An RNA-sequencing study of 54 tumours, which does not use the label, found significantly lower immune cell infiltration than in squamous carcinomas of the head and neck and of the lung, though significantly more B cells and monocytes. Against the label, a study of six thoracic tumours found cytotoxic T cells, macrophages and mature and immature tertiary lymphoid structures.

nodes.description: The tumour carries few mutations. In the NUT Carcinoma Registry the median tumour mutational burden was 1.0 mutation per megabase (range 0 to 16) and no tumour showed microsatellite instability; in the immune-biomarker review's pooled analysis of published thoracic and head and neck cases all 16 with data were microsatellite stable, with a median burden of 1.35 and none at the usual high-burden thresholds; and in a sequencing study none of the tumours tested had a burden of 10 or more per megabase. Whole-exome sequencing of two patients' tumours found burdens of 1.04 to 7.61 per megabase.
